definition: The plan validator, built before the generator on purpose, because a generator needs a measure of better and worse. It checks rooms, adjacency, privacy, daylight, servicing, code, style rules and named faults, and reports what it could not judge as unjudged.
basis: Editorial, from VISION.md's seventh layer: "The plan validator — built" before the composer, "on purpose, because a composer needs a fitness function and this is it." The pipeline scores each plan "against rooms, adjacency, privacy, daylight," servicing, code, style constraints and the fault corpus, and "Every check distinguishes evaluated-and-failed, evaluated-and-passed, and" could-not-evaluate.
